travel.image_caption: An Air India aircraft on the tarmac
travel.nri_angle: Diaspora students flying home to India for Diwali get the limited-time 10% discount plus a free date change on international bookings — the most valuable perk on pricey India–US/UK sectors.

travel.title: Five Days in South Sri Lanka: Surfing Weligama, Sunset at Galle Fort, Nightlife in Hiriketiya
travel.excerpt: A day-by-day plan for the southern coast — Talpe's quiet shores, Weligama's surf, Galle Fort's rampart sunsets, Mirissa's cafes, and Hiriketiya's dawn parties.

travel.nri_angle: Sri Lanka is a favorite short-haul getaway for the Indian diaspora, with direct flights from Chennai and Bengaluru and visa-free entry for Indians.

travel.title: Air India, Akasa Hike Fuel Surcharges Just as Diwali Travel Peaks
travel.excerpt: Domestic surcharges now reach ₹1,200 per leg and North America–India flights carry $215 each way, as all four major carriers raise charges within four days on soaring jet fuel prices.
travel.image_caption: Air India aircraft parked at an airport gate. The airline raised fuel surcharges on all new bookings from October 9, with domestic legs now carrying ₹400-₹1,200 extra.
travel.nri_angle: Diaspora flyers heading home for Diwali face higher fares across all Indian carriers: up to $215 per leg in fuel surcharges on North America–India routes.

carousel.title: Federal Court Postpones Rule Ending Duration of Status for Student Visas
carousel.excerpt: A federal judge in Massachusetts issued a nationwide injunction one day before a DHS rule was set to replace open-ended duration-of-status admissions with four-year caps for F and J visa holders — keeping the old system alive while the government appeals.
carousel.image_caption: Students on a US university campus. A federal court has postponed a rule ending duration of status for student visas.
carousel.nri_angle: Roughly 352,000 Indian students — the largest international-student cohort in the U.S. — are directly affected: the blocked rule's four-year cap and discretionary extension process would have hit Indian PhD and STEM OPT students hardest.

carousel.title: Flash Flood Devastates Villages in Nepal's Gorkha, Bridges Swept Away as 10 Go Missing
carousel.excerpt: A sudden surge in the Budhi Gandaki river swept away settlements, six bridges and a hydropower project in Gorkha district; the army and helicopters have been deployed as 10 people remain missing.
carousel.image_caption: A village in Nepal's Gorkha district. A flash flood devastated villages there, sweeping away bridges and homes as 10 went missing.
carousel.nri_angle: Nepal's diaspora in the US, Gulf and Australia will be checking on family in Gorkha; the region also draws Indian trekkers and pilgrims, and Indian authorities often coordinate relief with Kathmandu.

carousel.title: Abhishek's 69 and Arshdeep's Three-Fer Power India to 14-Run Win Over West Indies
carousel.excerpt: India defended 223 at Indore's Holkar Stadium to take a 2-1 lead in the five-match T20I series — the first successful defense by the team batting first on this tour.
carousel.image_caption: Abhishek Sharma bats for India during the third T20I against the West Indies at Indore. His 30-ball 69 powered India to a 14-run win and a 2-1 series lead.
carousel.nri_angle: India take a 2-1 series lead into the fourth T20I — a series-clinching win is now one result away, with Abhishek Sharma and Arshdeep Singh giving diaspora fans the headlines.

carousel.title: India's Semiconductor Market to Hit $200 Billion by 2035 as Five Plants Go Live: EY-IESA
carousel.excerpt: The EY-IESA report unveiled at SEMICON India 2026 projects threefold growth as commercial chip production begins at five units, including new lines at Mohali and Surat.
carousel.image_caption: Officials launch the EY-IESA report Semicon India 2.0 at SEMICON India 2026 in New Delhi. The report projects India semiconductor market will grow from nearly $64 billion in 2026 to $200 billion by 2035.
carousel.nri_angle: For Indian engineers in the US chip industry, the $200 billion projection maps where design centres, fab projects and supply-chain careers will grow over the next decade.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Weak US Jobs Report Pushes October Fed Rate Hike Odds Below 25%
carousel.excerpt: Just 29,000 jobs added in September against 90,000 expected, with steep downward revisions — futures markets now see the Fed standing pat at its October 27-28 meeting.
carousel.image_caption: The Marriner S. Eccles Federal Reserve building in Washington, D.C. A weak September jobs report pushed October Fed rate-hike odds below 25%.
carousel.nri_angle: NRI portfolios face the real tension: a Fed likely on hold in October but hiking in December keeps US mortgage rates elevated while supporting rate-sensitive equities — watch the December meeting, not October's.
